rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes limits of a static image, but it hedges by calling it early-full transition despite the lab grade of 2AA and adds some features not clearly verifiable from a single image.
Integrates age, BMI, PCOS, endometrium, sperm parameters, first-cycle status, and oocyte yield well with embryo prognosis, though AMH absence and PCOS implications are discussed somewhat broadly.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with prognosis and recommendations flowing from embryo quality and patient factors; only minor tension exists between image-based staging comments and the reported 2AA grade.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, cautions against unnecessary add-ons, and appropriately discusses PCOS/OHSS and selective use of PGT-A; minor speculative points prevent a perfect score.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support considerations, OHSS vigilance, and future-cycle planning, though some advice remains general rather than protocol-specific.
